title: heygen-com/hyperframes
claim: heygen-com/hyperframes — Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
why_good: It streamlines the process of creating video content for agents, addressing a niche need in the real estate and sales sectors.
value: Real estate agencies and sales teams could subscribe for premium features or pay per video rendered, creating a recurring revenue model.
risk: The technology could be easily replicated by larger video editing platforms or integrated into existing tools, limiting its market potential.
